rationale: Review 2026-11-12T21:11:56Z to 2026-11-12T21:16:36Z UTC. All cited text files re-hashed with one script against their recorded text_sha256 and every source_fingerprints entry; all matched. cruden.py number search (snapshot 28504e0c..., 49,073 readable sources) run for the order. Identity: held FR text (56 FR 10501) prints Executive Order 12753 of March 8, 1991, Nuclear Cooperation With EURATOM; it extends the sec. 126a(2) Atomic Energy Act period to March 10, 1992 and supersedes EO 12706. Basis: EO 12791 (March 9, 1992) 'Executive Order No. 12753 shall be superseded on the effective date of this Executive order.' The cited ACT record rests on an APP mirror capture; I read the same sentence in the held FR text of EO 12791 (57 FR 8717, ACTOR_TEXT:EO:12791, hash matched). Whole-order, unqualified supersession; and the order's own extension period ran out on March 10, 1992 in any case. Earlier end/partial scope: cruden found only EO 12791 (APP and FR); EO 12840 and EO 12903 merely list 12753 among earlier extensions. No savings, no revival, no flags. Accept.
